summary: Combo Milan MVP tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed covering /meta (9 categories with curve-glass sub, 6 brand groups), /groups create (main + curve-glass), confirm increment + persistence, /models, /submissions and /admin/verify (4321 -> ok:true, wrong -> ok:false). Frontend: verified home load, EN<->HI language toggle, 9 category rows, Curve Glass nested sub under Tempered Glass, admin flow with keypad 4321 -> add-data screen, group create appears on Home (Battery > Redmi/Poco), Confirm button increments count on card, Suggest a correction bottom sheet submits, universal search shows live results panel and tapping a result opens category+brand+card, Voltage Divider Calculator computes Vout = Vin*R2/(R1+R2) correctly (10*1000/2000=5V; 12*1000/4000=3V), Export to Excel triggers CSV download on web (combo-milan.csv), and wrong passcode stays on lock screen. No blocking issues found.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'could not find scrollable ref!' fires multiple times when the correction bottom sheet interacts with focused inputs. Likely a react-native-reanimated / bottom sheet ref wiring issue. Not blocking submission. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SuggestCorrectionSheet.tsx

Warning 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Set useNativeDriver:false on web or gate by Platform.OS to silence. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin-unlock.tsx:29-33
Deprecation warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Cosmetic but should be migrated for future RN versions.

action_items: (Optional) Silence useNativeDriver warning on web in admin-unlock shake animation (Platform-gate or set useNativeDriver:false when Platform.OS === 'web').
(Optional) Investigate 'could not find scrollable ref!' warnings coming from the Suggest Correction bottom sheet TextInputs.
(Optional) Migrate deprecated shadow* props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to be future-proof.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is concise and correct: MongoDB _id excluded via projection and pop, uuid ids used, HTTP 400/404 handled where relevant, ADMIN_PASSCODE read from env with a fallback. Good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL consistently in api.ts. All interactive elements carry testID. React Query invalidation used correctly on confirm/create.
Data persistence verified through Confirm (2 -> 3) surviving screen navigation, and created group visible via Home counts (3 groups, 2 verified).
seed_data_creation: Created via API tests and admin UI: compat_groups with TEST_/UITEST_ prefixes in Battery (Redmi/Poco, verified) and Tempered Glass > curve-glass (Samsung, unconfirmed); one model TEST_Redmi Note 12; one submission TEST_Redmi Note 11.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview DB now contains ~3 compat groups (Battery x2 verified, Tempered Glass curve-glass x1 unconfirmed), 1 model and 1 pending submission with UITEST_/TEST_ prefixes. Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin passcode: 4321. Language toggle initial value = 'EN' (button text switches to 'हि' after tap). Key selectors: [data-testid='category-<id>'], [data-testid='sub-<catId>:<subKey>'], [data-testid='brand-<catId>|<sub|main>|<brand>'], [data-testid='key-<digit>'], [data-testid='save-group'], [data-testid='input-vin|r1|r2'], [data-testid='vout-result'], [data-testid='action-export|action-calculator|action-add-data'], [data-testid='search-input'], [data-testid='result-<id>']. Note: on web the export triggers a real file download; use expect_download in Playwright.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no issues to root-cause. Only minor console deprecation/animation warnings noted above; none affect functionality.
